_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing polite lines for work

items.native: क्या मैं एक सवाल पूछ सकूँ?

items.en: I will check and tell you.

segments.text: Talking at work? Here are four polite lines. Repeat after me.
I will check and tell you.

native.hook: ऑफिस में विनम्रता से कैसे बोलें?
native.caption: ऑफिस में अंग्रेज़ी बोलते हुए झिझक होती है? ये 4 वाक्य सहेज लीजिए, जैसे “Can I ask a question?” और “Thank you for the help.” Ama टीचर को सुनिए और ख़ामोशी में ख़ुद दोहराइए। Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास कीजिए।

en.hook: How do you speak politely at work?
en.caption: Do you hesitate to speak English at the office? Save these 4 lines, such as “Can I ask a question?” and “Thank you for the help.” Listen to teacher Ama and repeat in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
